biggest_catch: The rewards are both discounts, not cash: your friend gets 20% off their first box (with a $100 minimum spend) and you get $35 off your next Daily Harvest order.
catches: Friend's reward: 20% off their first Daily Harvest box when they spend at least $100.
Your reward: $35 off your next order after your friend's first purchase.

The referral must create an account and make their first purchase through your referral link — providing a valid email to the program and having the friend purchase via the emailed link are the mechanics.
No per-referrer cap was stated in the official terms reviewed; third-party pages describe it as unlimited, but that is not confirmed in the official terms.
Daily Harvest states the incentive 'may fluctuate' by time of year and promotions — amounts can change.
Both rewards are store discounts usable only on Daily Harvest orders, not cash.

c2.evidence: Official Daily Harvest FAQ states the 20%-off/$100-first-box friend reward and $35-off referrer reward; the financial-incentive notice confirms both sides receive the incentive on first purchase.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate in the referral program.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Give your friends 20% off when they spend $100 on their first Daily Harvest box. You'll also get $35 off your next order.' Honest disclosure: these are order discounts, not cash.

eligibility: Referrer: an existing Daily Harvest customer who provides the referral's email through the Refer a Friend program. Friend: a new customer who receives the emailed link, creates an account, and makes their first purchase through it.

payout_quote: Official Daily Harvest FAQ: 'Yes! If you love it, share it. Give your friends 20% off when they spend $100 on their first Daily Harvest box. You'll also get $35 off your next order.' Official Notice of Financial Incentive (daily-harvest.com/pages/notice-of-financial-incentive): 'This financial incentive provides a discount on the customer's next purchase after the referral uses the customer's referral link to make their first purchase... The customer's referral is then sent an email and must use the link contained therein to create an account and make their first purchase in order for the customer and referral to receive the financial incentive.' Also: 'The incentive may fluctuate based on time of year, applicable social events such as upcoming holidays, higher or lower sales months.'

steps: In your Daily Harvest account, enter your friend's email in the Refer a Friend program.
Your friend receives the emailed referral link.
Your friend clicks the link, creates a Daily Harvest account, and spends at least $100 on their first box — getting 20% off.
You receive $35 off your next Daily Harvest order.
Track referral progress on the Refer a Friend dashboard in your account.
timing: Reward triggers on the friend's first purchase via the referral link; no stated expiry, but amounts may fluctuate with promotions.
